overall_summary: The channel's performance is heavily driven by extreme space anomalies and planetary facts (e.g., planets of burning ice, coal-dark atmospheres, and metallic rain), which consistently achieve the highest view counts (up to 1,055 views) and engagement. In contrast, psychology, brain hacks, and cognitive facts are severely underperforming, rarely breaking 100 views.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'The Planet of Burning Ice' (1,055 views), 'The Planet Darker Than Coal' (965 views), and 'The Planet Where It Rains Molten Iron' (353 views) represent the top tier of performance.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on extreme cosmic environments, bizarre planetary weather, and mind-bending space physics.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'Sharks Are Older Than Trees' (302 views) and 'Why Your Head Is Older Than Your Feet' (262 views) show solid baseline performance.
winning_patterns.action: Incorporate comparative science facts that challenge common sense or time perception.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'Your Brain Is Hiding This From You' (38 views) and 'The Real Reason Songs Get Stuck In Your Head' (17 views) consistently fail to gain traction.
weak_patterns.action: Pivot away from cognitive psychology and brain tricks to focus resources on cosmic and physical science.

weak_patterns.evidence: Re-uploading 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' multiple times resulted in extremely low views (5, 53, and 0 views).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid re-uploading concepts that fail to clear the initial view threshold; instead, iterate on the topic or change the niche entirely.
